name: Astrology
overview: Scripture reveals that God created the celestial bodies to serve practical purposes such as marking times and seasons (Genesis 1:14), but explicitly forbids seeking guidance from them or engaging in practices like enchantment, divination, or consulting familiar spirits (Leviticus 19:26, 19:31, 20:6). The Bible warns against lifting one's eyes to the stars with the intent to worship or serve them, as this leads away from the true God who has apportioned the heavens (Deuteronomy 4:19). Faithful obedience to God's covenant requires rejecting all forms of occult practices, including astrology, which are seen as wickedness in His sight (Deuteronomy 17:2).
